body: We will probably need some more details like specific hardware details for the devices this happens on
@OS0DEVELOPER please try to provide more details about the devices this happens on

Affected Devices & Specs:

   -

   *Infinix GT 20 Pro* (Android 15, SDK 35) — MediaTek Dimensity 8200
   Ultimate (Mali-G610 MC6)
   -

   *Samsung Galaxy A15 5G / M15 5G* (Android 15, SDK 35) — MediaTek
   Dimensity 6100+ (Mali-G57 MC2)
   -

   *Motorola Moto G34* (Android 15, SDK 35) — Snapdragon 695 (Adreno
619) *Note:
   This one exhibits the identical recursive_mutex::lock() thread lockup via
   GodotLib_step, even though it is an Adreno target.*

Additional Context:

   -

   *Reproduction Pattern:* The app runs perfectly during the initial boot
   session. The crash (SIGABRT / SIGSEGV) or an unresponsive UI input
   lockup specifically triggers when a player drops back to the main menu,
   adjusts standard quality settings (like toggling MSAA/Environment states),
   and attempts to transition back to a heavy 3D scene (containing roughly
   3,000+ instantiated objects).
   -

   *Workaround Behavior:* Toggling change_scene_to_packed to use
   .call_deferred() combined with flushing the command buffer via
   RenderingServer.force_draw() right before the tree swap alleviates the
   frequency of the lockup. This strongly points to a race condition with
   thread management/mutex lifecycles during target execution in
   GodotLib_step when interacting with the graphics driver pipelines.

   its Always MediaTek and Vulkan issue Snapdragon Runs Smoth
